segments.text: The mysterious girl who appears before the newly ennobled Siegfried Maired and offers to help him with the management of his new fiefdom in exchange for marriage and official status as the feudal lord's wife. She is well-versed in the ways of the nobility and frequently lectures Siegfried on his roles and responsibilities as a baron. Marriage is a transaction for Leona and she gives Siegfried permission to sleep with other women for release of his sexual desires and to sire heirs to continue the family lineage. On the other hand she refuses to sleep with Siegfried as her role in managing the fief is critical and she can't run around when heavily pregnant.

Her true name is Alfreya Lesbel, the daughter of the earl who ruled over the lands now entrusted to Siegfried. She was sheltered by another family when her father's lands were seized and learnt her craft after returning to her birthplace three years prior to Siegfried's arrival. She proposed marriage to Siegfried after discovering he knew nothing about feudal management in order to continue her work at his side; all for the sake of preventing the fief from collapsing under mismanagement.
She harbours a homicidal hatred of thieves in her demesne.
ジークの前に現れた謎の少女。
なぜか領地経営に関しての知識があり、ジークの領地経営を助ける代わりに妻の地位を求める。
でもHはしばらくお預け!
「お腹が大きくなったら領地経営を助けられないじゃない」
性格は温和だが、行動的。
争いは好まないが領地を守る為なら多少の無茶はする。

Originally a member of the Knightly Order of the Red Bear, she is forced to carry the can after her Order is disgraced when the second prince they were assigned to protect perished in the recent war. Her humble origins and lack of political connections are the reason for her dishonourable discharge, but she is directed to the Maired fief with a letter of recommendation after meeting Rose at the insistence of her former commander.

Yorminate knew Siegfried prior to his ennoblement as he was in charge of cleaning the sleeping quarters of the Knightly Order during the recent war. Because of their prior acquaintance, she is entrusted with command of the fief's army.

Her reputation as one of the best fighters in the kingdom precedes her even in the distant Maired fief. Her training regimen for the fief's army is commensurately spartan. She is also the kingdom's best chess player with challengers making the fifteen day trip from the capital to the Maired fief hoping to supplant her.
王都の赤熊騎士団に所属していたが、第二王子の死亡の責任を単身で担う形で解雇。
新たな就職先を探しているところ、知り合いであるジークを頼った。
訓練大好きの戦闘系。
指揮官としての能力は高いが恋愛面は……
真面目系。
主人公の領地の武力担当として活躍。

actors.name: 霧島はるな(水無月じゅん)

segments.text: The manager of the "Purple Moon" brothel located in the Braudel Kingdom capital. She is invited by Leona to act as the Maired family's contact in the capital, duties including information gathering at the royal court and providing accommodation for Siegfried when he visits the capital.
Rose sends Yominate onwards to the Maired fief after the latter comes to her establishment seeking employment.

Although Rose is a high-class prostitute who only services the upper echelons of the nobility, it is Lisa who acts as Rose's body double during sex. Rose is responsible for building up the Purple Moon establishment to its current status. As the former princess of a vanquished kingdom now under Braudel rule, the brothel was supposed to be a front allowing the surviving diaspora to lie low for a chance of revenge. Lisa and Rose saw Siegfried as a potential protector because of his new status and this was a major reason behind their acceptance of Leona's offer despite its lack of financial compensation.
She is revealed to be younger than Siegfried in the game's Omake section.
王都で経営されている貴族相手の高級娼館の女主人。
本人も客を取るが、相手を選ぶので有名。
王族の相手をした事もあるとの噂も。
高級娼婦は色事だけでなく、パーティに女性役で出席したり、家庭教師や相談役的な仕事をする事もあるスーパーエリート。
主人公の王都での相談役として登場。

segments.text: The fourth son of a destitute noble family, the combination of volatile factional strife, war with a neighbouring kingdom and fortuitous chance results in his enfeoffment as the new baron of the hitherto extinct noble Maidred family.

Entrusted with the lands of the deposed Earldom of Lesbel, he is caught in a bind as he has zero experience as a feudal liege. Without help from the royal court and effectively disowned from his real family, his encounter with a mysterious woman with the experience and skills he desperately craves signals the start of his journey as the newest of the Braudel Kingdom's feudal lords.

A high-ranking member of the Church in the Braudel Kingdom capital.

Affable and generous, her saintly behaviour draws admirers from afar. However, her popularity draws the ire of the Church's upper echelons who exile her from the capital to preserve their vested interests.
Ellie makes her appearance in the game after players construct the cathedral building.
ブラウベル王都の教会のお偉いさん。
温和で優しく、聖女のような振る舞いをする。それゆえ、王都の教会内の上層部に立場を脅かす存在として危険視され、外に追い出された。
追い出された先がマイレッド領。
「マイレッド領で活動する事をお許し頂きたく、ご挨拶に参りました」
A skilled merchant looking to make her mark in the new Maired fief. She agrees to trade on behalf of Siegfried in exchange for official license to operate.

Although she hails from a long line of merchants, she has chosen to strike out on her own without family help. Any success or failure she incurs when operating in Maired lands is down to her achievements or mistakes alone.
ジークの領地にお金の匂いを感じ、やってきた新進気鋭の交易商人!お金儲けの為なら危険な道を全力で……は行かない。安全マージンを確保した上で、余裕のある範囲でギャンブル!
そう心掛けているのに負けが込むと熱くなってしまって……
商人としては優秀。
「金を出してくれなら、ウチがマイレッド領の商売、まとめたるわ。どや」

cast.characterName: コルネッタ＝ブラウベル
cast.originalCharacterName: コルネッタ＝ブラウベル

segments.text: The second princess of the Brauvel kingdom. Originally intended to be married off to a neighbouring kingdom, the arrangement was cancelled after her fiance perished from illness. Her presence is not welcomed by her surviving brothers who see her as a threat to their dynastic ambitions. Her faction is the weakest with no support from anyone at the start of the game.

Despite her plight, she is still a member of the Brauvel ruling family and has the authority to order public works and other administrative commands. She is ably supported by her circle of palace maids (comprised of the daughters of noble families) who are absolutely loyal to her.

Rose's body double. She makes initial contact with Siegfried Maired after accepting Leona's offer. Siegfried's reluctance to immerse himself in the sexual norms of noble society forces Liza to implement a training regimen requiring Siegfried to have sex with the household maids and to partake in certain virility boosting foods.
Each time Siegfried visits the capital, Liza puts his sexual experience to the test personally or via proxy.
